title: Preparation of Phosphate-buffered Saline (PBS)
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p4rdqv6
materials: Dissolve reagents in 800 mL of triple distilled H₂O using a magnetic stirrer and flea or by manual shaking.

steps.title: Weigh Reagents
steps.instruction: Weigh out the required reagents based on the desired final concentration of the PBS solution.

substeps.instruction: For 1x PBS: NaCl (8g), KCl (0.2g), Na₂HPO₄ (1.44g), and KH₂PO₄ (0.24g).
For 10x PBS: NaCl (80g), KCl (2g), Na₂HPO₄ (14.4g), and KH₂PO₄ (2.4g).

steps.title: Adjust pH
steps.instruction: Adjust the pH of the solution to 7.4 (or 7.2 if required) using a pH meter and concentrated hydrochloric acid (HCl).

steps.title: Bring to Final Volume
steps.instruction: Add triple distilled H₂O to bring the final volume of the solution to 1 L.

steps.title: Make RNase Free (Optional)
steps.instruction: If RNase free PBS is required, add DEPC (diethyl pyrocarbonate) to the solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of DEPC per 1 L of PBS.
